newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times business - Sept 3.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times business - Sept 3.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following business stories on Tuesday:
* Former Securities and Exchange Commission enforcement chief Gary Lynch is being criticised for defending some companies against alleged wrongdoing.
* AMR Corp's American Airlines and its pilots reach contract accord.
* Digital Equipment Corp faces a tough market in which to sell its Altavista Internet Software Inc division.
* Federal Reserve ponders possibility that inflation is extinct.
* United Auto Workers union moves closer to picking Ford Motor Co for a final round of national labour talks.
* Chase Manhattan Corp starts to cover Chemical Bank signs at branches, a first tangible sign for customers of the banks' merger.
* Boeing Co announces $6.3 billion in orders.
* Oil prices surge on Mideast tension.
* Morgan Grenfell Asset Management halts trading in three funds and suspends manager because of possible irregularities.
* Warburg Pincus Ventures invests $20 million in cable's Classic Sports Network.
* Northeast Utilities nuclear plant has hundreds of problems.
